title: ContractVille
provenance: Reported by ObT1337 (highball#202, 2026-09-25), Apple M1, macOS 15.6.1, Highball 0.9.35, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r7, DXVK mode: the logos play, then a black screen. Reproduced by the maintainer on 2026-09-26 on an M1 Pro, macOS 27.0, engine r7: on DXVK the game reaches its loading screen and never leaves it, on DXMT it crashes at start.
notes: Unreal Engine 4.27 with the Epic Online Services SDK (EOSCore plugin) and the AsyncLoadingScreen plugin. Measured here on 2026-09-26, engine r7, M1 Pro: on DXVK the intros play, then the loading screen (the plugin's slides with Loading... at the bottom) stays for 20 minutes with the game ticking, memory flat and nothing loading. It is not the videos: with Media Foundation off for the game (mfplat=) the intros are skipped and the same loading screen stays, and with the Movies folder set aside it stays too. A trace of the Epic Online Services SDK's own calls shows it initialises normally (its HTTP and websocket threads start, it reads its EOS_ variables) and then sits idle, never asked to log in, and the game never resolves an Epic hostname. So the game's startup logic stops at a step before the Epic login, which one is not known. ProtonDB rates it Gold on Linux, so the wait is specific to this platform. Still being looked at. On DXMT the game crashes at start: D3D11 CreateTexture2D with the shared flag (D3D11_RESOURCE_MISC_SHARED, 500x500 R16G16B16A16_FLOAT) returns E_FAIL on DXMT 0.80. No frame rate, the game was not reached.

knownIssues.symptom: Black screen or an endless loading screen after the startup logos (reported on an M1, macOS 15.6.1, engine r7, DXVK, highball#202, reproduced on an M1 Pro, macOS 27.0).
knownIssues.cause: not confirmed. Not the intro videos, they play or skip and the wait is the same. The Epic Online Services SDK initialises and then idles, never asked to log in, so the game's own startup logic stops one step earlier for a reason not found yet.
knownIssues.fix: none yet. Media Foundation off for the game (DLL overrides mfplat=) only skips the intros and does not get past the loading screen.

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes at start on DXMT with the Unreal crash reporter (measured on an M1 Pro, engine r7, DXMT 0.80).
knownIssues.cause: measured: the game creates a shared D3D11 render target (MISC_SHARED, R16G16B16A16_FLOAT) and DXMT returns E_FAIL, which Unreal treats as fatal.
knownIssues.fix: use the DXVK mode, which accepts the texture.

dxvk.detail: intros and loading screen render, the loading screen never ends (M1 Pro, engine r7, 2026-09-26)

dxmt.detail: crash at start, shared D3D11 texture creation returns E_FAIL on DXMT 0.80
